# uzfintech-skills

> Agent skills with exact API contracts for the payment providers of Uzbekistan: Uzum Bank, Alif, Click, Paynet, Payme, Multicard, Atmos, Octo, Oson and Kapitalbank, plus a cross-provider fiscal receipt skill and a router skill for choosing and comparing providers. Each skill is a SKILL.md router with contract notes, trimmed JSON Schemas, anonymized examples, vendor sandbox data, lifecycle rules (deadlines, cancel / refund, retries, fiscal receipts), checklists, and two python3 tools that compute signatures and validate payloads.

To choose or compare providers, start with the uzfintech router skill. Otherwise read the provider's SKILL.md first and follow its pointers. Run scripts/sign.py and scripts/validate.py instead of computing signatures by hand. Amounts: Payme and Atmos in tiyin, Click and Oson in sum, Octo in major units; check each provider's SKILL.md. Commission rates and settlement terms are per merchant contract and are not in the skills.

## Skills

- [Uzum Bank](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/uzum/SKILL.md): Merchant API webhooks, Checkout, Fiscalization, FastPay, Dynamic QR, CrossBorder, Remit Core, Ratekeeper, Nasiya, PaymentHub
- [Alif](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/alif/SKILL.md): alifpay Checkout, Alif Nasiya instalments, Payments, Cards, Hold, Monitoring, Summary, legacy API map
- [Click](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/click/SKILL.md): SHOP API, Advanced / Split Shop, Merchant API, card tokens, Fiscalization, CLICK Pass, Telegram Payments
- [Paynet](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/paynet/SKILL.md): internet acquiring for Humo and Uzcard
- [Payme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/payme/SKILL.md): Merchant API, Subscribe API, Checkout, Fiscalization
- [Multicard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/multicard/SKILL.md): invoices, card binding, payments, refunds, holds, payouts, reports
- [Atmos](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/atmos/SKILL.md): Uzcard / Humo payments, reversals, card linking, holds, withdrawal by PINFL, Visa / Mastercard (MPS / IPS), Callback API
- [Octo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/octo/SKILL.md): payment page (one-stage / two-stage), own card form, card tokens, refunds, fiscalization
- [Oson](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/oson/SKILL.md): invoice API and signed payment notification, rebuilt from Oson's open-source shop plugins
- [Kapitalbank](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/kapitalbank/SKILL.md): Kapital API for legal entities (payment orders, status, statements, account checks, exchange rates, invoices) and CBU payment purpose codes
- [Fiscal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/fiscal/SKILL.md): MXIK (IKPU) and package codes, VAT and benefit fields, marking, receipt types, per-provider receipt fields
- [Router](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ansoragroup/uzfintech-skills/main/skills/uzfintech/SKILL.md): choose and compare providers; cross-provider cheatsheet of units, auth, callbacks, refunds, holds, fiscalization and test hosts; UzQR notes
